title: Parallel derivations merged by original identity
turns: Coerce x from numbers.csv to integer with type_coerce. Fork each row into two parallel branches. One branch uses value_transform to add doubled=x*2; the other adds squared=x*x. Join both results by original row identity with require-all coalesce and flat union merge. Shared id and x agree; first_wins is acceptable for these equal shared values. Preserve both computed fields. Use field_mapper to write exactly id,x,doubled,squared to combined.jsonl. Do not serialize both calculations into one branch. Validate and preview.

review_policy.constraints: Inspect each presented draft against every explicit requirement in turns. Accept only matching meanings; never approve a changed output, dropped row, weaker type or unrelated requirement. Source data must match supplied input bytes; any model choice must retain the approved sonnet profile.
